protocol.packet: u64be byte length || JSON; length 1..2097152 checked before allocation
protocol.json: v1 Swift associated-value _0 boxes; uppercase Codable UUID, lowercase transcript UUID; padded standard base64 Data; whole-second UTC time; absent nil; sorted keys/no whitespace/unescaped slash. v2 explicit tagged snake_case envelopes deny unknown fields. Query typed timestamps use separate higher-precision Swift canonical serializer.

primitives: X25519 raw32-byte shared secret; all-zero rejected
HMAC-SHA256 client/server proofs with selector-specific domains
SHA256 code_key and session derivation; no HKDF substitution
IETF ChaCha20-Poly1305 nonce12/tag16 empty AAD; cryptographically fresh random nonce
crypto.secure_envelope: HMDSC001 || u64be sequence || payload; independent directions start0; every control/chunk consumes sequence. Unexpected plaintext/magic, duplicate/skipped/order mismatch fail closed.
crypto.source_qualification: Current Rust counters use wrapping_add(1); no claim of tested u64 rollover; host lifecycle must be separately qualified. Native AEAD/key/random/credential ownership stays host.

protocol.binary_frame: HMDDIRCT 8 bytes || u16be1 || rawUUID16 || u32be sequence>=1 || u32be payload_count || rawSHA25632 || payload<=524288; header66, lengths/hash checked
protocol.qr: healthmd://direct-cli/pair exactly host/port/code; <=512 ASCII bytes, no whitespace/control/percent encoding/fragment/credentials; canonical RFC1918 or100.64/10 IPv4; port1..65535;20 ASCII digits; in-app consent only; no browsable external handler

durable_state.flow: persist immutable queued request -> connecting -> sent/accepted -> preparing/transferring -> durable local assembled commit -> awaiting_peer_acknowledgement -> final ack/retry -> completionConfirmed -> completed. Transport failure -> paused unless terminal or awaiting ack. Explicit cancel -> cancellation_pending persisted -> peer acknowledged cancelled -> cancelled; timeout remains pending. Peer terminal errors -> failed; already_committed only exact descriptor; status reads local journal.
durable_state.frontier: Globally contiguous zero-based partitions; per-partition chunk sequence starts1; previous partition SHA256 chain, byte counts and exact descriptor; request fingerprint/peer/session/source pin. Stage and record committed frontier before ack; no resend accounting twice.
durable_state.retention: 7-day expiry; shared64-job and128GiB aggregate quota across v1/v2;64GiB per-job,16384 partitions,100000 generated files,36600 dates,1MiB job record,64MiB durable JSON,512MiB free-space reserve. Future materialization reserves three additional input copies. Atomic journals and serialized execution/storage leases.
durable_state.recovery: Completed raw read verifies retained exact size/hash. Lost local/source spool is truthful missing/restart-required, never fabricated data or recapture under retained job. Frozen exporter engine/profile authority remains retained.
